get.description:
Global search across messages, contacts, and media.

- Searches message bodies, contact names/numbers, media paths
- Filters by app (WhatsApp/Telegram/All)
- Returns categorized results

Search messages with filters.

- Full-text search on message body
- Date range filter (date_from, date_to)
- App filter (whatsapp/telegram/all)
- Pagination support

Search contacts with filters.

- Full-text search on name, phone, username, JID
- App filter (whatsapp/telegram/all)
- Pagination support

Search media with filters.

- Search on file path/name
- Date range filter
- App filter (whatsapp/telegram/all)
- Media type filter (image/video/audio/document)
- Pagination support

Get search summary statistics for a case.

Returns counts of messages, contacts, and media,
along with date ranges and available apps.

Get comprehensive statistics for a case.

Returns:
- Total messages across all apps
- Total contacts
- Total media files
- Total deleted messages
- Total groups
- Per-app stats (WhatsApp, Telegram)

Get correlation statistics for a case.

Returns:
- Total correlation edges
- Message-contact links
- Message-media links
- Cross-app links

Get timeline event statistics for a case.

Returns:
- Total events
- Events by type
- Events by app
- Date range

Get comprehensive case overview for dashboard.

Returns all dashboard data including:
- Case information
- Statistics (messages, contacts, media, etc.)
- Correlation statistics
- Timeline statistics
- Recent events
- Available apps and date range
